dct_description_sm: Contained within the Atlas of Canada's Reference Map Series, 1961 to 2010, is Sheet 1 of the Geographical Map Series. It shows relief (using 10 classes), and bathymetry (using 11 classes). The class limits are in feet, but metric equivalents of these limits are also given. The base map components consist only of major rivers and lakes, and provincial and territorial boundaries for Canada - no names of any kind are shown. The data used was that available as of about 1975.
